title: Recording manifest
description: Written by the Main phone and uploaded after recording stops. Lists every segment the phones are expected to upload; processing starts only once every listed segment is in S3. A recording made on the Main phone alone has one device and no clockSync.

gameId.description: Game this recording belongs to. A game can have several sessions (e.g. one per half).

sessionId.description: One continuous start-to-stop recording on both phones.

clockSync.description: BLE ping/pong estimate of the Secondary clock relative to the Main clock. Only a starting point; processing refines the offset by cross-correlating audio.

model.description: Mount used, e.g. a dual-phone tripod mount.

position.description: Side of the mount. Processing can detect this from feature matches when unknown.

nominalFps.description: Requested frame rate. Phones record variable frame rate; processing resamples on presentation timestamps.

horizontalFovDeg.description: Recorded horizontal field of view as reported by the camera. Seeds stitching.

stabilization.description: Must be false; stabilization breaks the fixed stitch.

objectKey.description: Path relative to the recording, <deviceId>/<fileName>. The server places it under the uploading account; phones never choose full bucket keys.

startedAtDeviceMs.description: Device clock (ms since epoch) when the first frame was captured.
